name: Three-Alarm Flavor
body:
We’re going to have to ask you to sign this waiver.

Prerequisite(s): Add Spice to Taste, 1st-level culinarian.

Benefit(s): When you consume a meal with a spicy flavor profile on your turn, you can use a standard action to cast burning hands as a sorcerer of your character level. If the meal contains at least 3 spicy flavor profiles, you can cast dragon’s breath to breathe a 30-foot cone of flame instead.
